name: github_pr_code_review_diff_ts
display_name: GitHub PR Code Review Diff Tool (TypeScript)
description: Fetches changed files and patch details for an open GitHub pull request for automated code review workflows.

pull_request_url.description: Full GitHub pull request URL, for example https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/123

owner.description: GitHub repository owner. Use with repo and pull_number when pull_request_url is omitted.

repo.description: GitHub repository name. Use with owner and pull_number when pull_request_url is omitted.

pull_number.description: GitHub pull request number. Use with owner and repo when pull_request_url is omitted.

token.description: Optional GitHub token. Reads GITHUB_TOKEN from the environment when omitted.
